旧金山的海风半日：Lands End 与 Sutro Baths 短线攻略: A coastal half-day in San Francisco: Lands End and Sutro Baths
从浴场遗址的上方看海，再走一段能随时折返的海岸步道: View the bath ruins from above, then take a coastal walk with an easy turnaround
把遗址观景、柏树林与海岸短线串起来，分清无障碍路段、陡坡和台阶，给雾天与带娃出游: Combine ruins, cypress groves, and a short coastal walk while distinguishing accessible paths from steep slopes and stairs, with options for fog and families.
了解海岸步道、观景与保持悬崖距离的官方提醒。: Coastal trails, overlooks, and official advice to stay away from cliff edges.
Merrie Way 起点至无障碍观景点的路段，以及后续台阶和不平路面。: The accessible section from Merrie Way to the overlook, followed by stairs and uneven terrain.
下到浴场的铺装路很陡，并有裂缝与高差；核对停车和洗手间位置。: The paved descent to the baths is very steep, with cracks and level changes; check parking and restroom locations.
Lands End 的吸引力是城市忽然退到身后：柏树之间露出海面，旧浴场的轮廓又: At Lands End, the city seems to fall away: ocean appears between cypress trees, while the old bath ruins recall San Francisco’s past. A first visit need not cover the entire trail. Read the ruins from above, then follow the coast as far as feels comfortable. Even in fog, the trees, rocky shore, and waves make a rewarding half-day.
先确定起点与当天能走多远: Choose your starting point and a comfortable distance
建议预留 2–3 小时，包含观景与休息；这是编辑安排，不是官方步行时间。: Allow an editorial estimate of 2–3 hours for views and breaks; this is not an official walking time.
户外散步与遗址观景无需景点门票；餐饮、交通及可能的停车支出另算。: Outdoor walking and viewing the ruins require no attraction ticket; budget separately for food, transport, and any parking costs.
以 Lands End Lookout / Merrie Way 为集合点；驾车: Meet at Lands End Lookout / Merrie Way. Drivers should check parking signs; transit users should confirm their arrival stop and return direction for the day.
三站短线：先认遗址，再走海岸: Three short stops: ruins first, then the coast
从 Lookout 出发的可折返路线: An out-and-back route from the Lookout
以下停留为编辑建议；地图用于找入口，具体通行以现场路牌为准。: Stops below are editorial suggestions. Maps locate entrances; follow on-site signs for actual access.
先在游客中心周边辨认海岸方向，看看外部地形模型，再决定是否进入当天开放的展区。把: Begin around the visitor center by identifying the coastline and examining the outdoor landscape model, then visit any exhibits open that day. Use this stop for restrooms and water. Ask children to locate the baths, ocean, and trail so that the walk becomes an exploration rather than a march.
第二站 · Sutro Baths 上方观景: Stop 2 · View Sutro Baths from above
在正式步道与观景位置停下，比较水池残壁与海浪的位置，想象昔日浴场的规模。主路线保: Pause on designated paths and viewpoints to compare the surviving pool walls with the waves and imagine the baths’ former scale. The main itinerary stays above the ruins. Descending is an optional steep detour; skip it in slippery conditions, strong winds, or fatigue, and avoid shortcuts along walls or exposed edges.
第三站 · Coastal Trail 短段折返: Stop 3 · A short Coastal Trail out-and-back
回到 Merrie Way 一侧的步道起点，沿官方标示路线进入树荫与海岸视野。先: Return to the trailhead by Merrie Way and follow marked paths through trees and coastal views. Use the accessible overlook as an initial turnaround, pausing for the wind and distant headlands. Beyond it are stairs and uneven surfaces; extend only if everyone is comfortable, and return along the familiar route.
把海风、坡度与返程一起安排: Plan for wind, gradients, and the return trip
轮椅或推车优先走 Merrie Way 至无障碍观景点的短段，不能把整条海岸线视: For wheelchairs or strollers, prioritize the short section from Merrie Way to the accessible overlook; the entire coast is not step-free. Although paved, the bath descent is officially described as very steep and cracked. Bring a windproof layer and grippy shoes. Shorten the walk in heavy fog and keep children close. Regroup at the Lookout and check transport before darkness.

先查返程公交或停车安排，预留天黑前离开的时间。: Check return transit or parking arrangements and leave time to depart before dark.
